description: Opaque muted teal-blue floor-length overdress over a cream underdress, with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length upper sleeves. Gold cloud, knot and geometric woven borders trace the neckline, vertical front, cuffs and hem. Two round decorative brooches sit at the front shoulder straps. A broad teal-and-gold woven waist belt has a round ornate clasp and dangling metal ornaments with tassels. Cream shawl rests over the forearms and hangs at both sides, edged with gold and blue woven patterns. Brown patterned closed shoes are visible beneath the skirt. No headgear, armor or weapon is present.
